note: 502-acre state park in a limestone canyon reached via Lost Creek Rd ~6 mi N of Anaconda; a short trail leads to 50-ft Lost Creek Falls. Narrow dirt access road (tight even for small rigs). --Claude
summary: FWP page: confirmed 25 first-come sites, vault toilets and water; added the 23-ft RV/trailer limit (max_rig_ft). Fees left as recorded (page gives only the statewide $4-$34 range). Season left derived: FWP states only the PARK's season ('Open mid to late May through November 30') and that the campground 'Can become inaccessible due to snow in October and November'. Hookups not stated (derived none left). Note trimmed of restated facts.
